criteria: Statewide or multi-county draw, recurs yearly, organizer has its own website. One entry per recurring tradition, never per year. Regions: NW, NE, Central, Tampa Bay (includes Sarasota and Manatee), SW (Lee, Collier, Charlotte), SE, Keys. Tags florida-icon, major-music-festival, tentpole and only-in-florida are editorial labels copied from wf_events only; entries added from outside wf_events carry none of them. confirmed_dated means a wf_events row with future or in-progress dates is linked via event_id; expected_undated means the next edition has no verified dates; event_id is null unless a wf_events row exists whose event_status is not scheduled (then it stays linked). event_series_id is copied from the linked row. probe:false marks hosts that must never be fetched by automation. note records uncertainty. Dates come only from wf_events and are never invented. lead_dates (expected_undated only) are organizer-stated next-edition dates whose year is printed on the organizer page; they are never shown as verified until a wf_events row exists. source_url stays null until an organizer page has been read for that entry.
